captions.detailed: A pedestal cantilever inspection arm featuring a dark gray vertical support post on a rectangular base plate with mounting holes. The post connects to a multi-link serial arm chain consisting of a thick, light gray shoulder link, a slimmer light gray forelink, and a dark gray compact wrist block at the tip. The shoulder, elbow, and wrist joints are designed to pivot sequentially on supported pin axes to extend or position the arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a pedestal cantilever inspection arm in CadQuery. The model should include a dark gray base plate and post, a light gray shoulder link, a slimmer light gray forelink, and a dark gray compact end-effector block, with successive pivoting joints connecting each segment.
captions.factory: Construct the base post and plate using box primitives combined with boolean operations. Model the shoulder link and forelink as extruded rectangular shapes with rounded corners or chamfered edges, incorporating pivot holes. Assemble the segments sequentially by applying translation and rotation transformations to position each link relative to its predecessor, and assign contrasting dark gray and light gray material colors to the respective components.
